title: Null-measurability of Lipschitz images under Simon-normalized Hausdorff measure (Simon 2.1.8(i), measurability)
statement: Let X be a σ-compact metric space and Y a metric space, both with their Borel σ-algebras. Let m ≥ 0 be real and 𝓗^m := Chapter01.simonHausdorffMeasureReal m (on X and on Y). Let A ⊆ X be 𝓗^m-null-measurable with 𝓗^m(A) < ∞, K ∈ ℝ≥0, and f : X → Y K-Lipschitz on A. Then f(A) is 𝓗^m-null-measurable in Y.
lean_statement: ∀ (X Y : Type) [MetricSpace X] [SigmaCompactSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] [MetricSpace Y] [MeasurableSpace Y] [BorelSpace Y] (m : ℝ) (A : Set X) (f : X → Y) (K : ℝ≥0), 0 ≤ m → NullMeasurableSet A (Chapter01.simonHausdorffMeasureReal m) → Chapter01.simonHausdorffMeasureReal m A < ⊤ → LipschitzOnWith K f A → NullMeasurableSet (f '' A) (Chapter01.simonHausdorffMeasureReal m)
